---
title: "Teaching"
---

At Bocconi I have developed and currently direct multiple courses that
integrate Data Science, AI, and computational methods into the MSc. and
BSc. curricula in Accounting and AI. The aim is to make students fluent
in advanced analytical techniques — from Natural Language Processing to
Blockchain fundamentals — so they can lead in data-rich accounting and
finance environments.

In 2023–2024 I received the **Bocconi Teaching Award for Innovation** for
the course *Introduction to Blockchain*.

## Current courses — Bocconi University

### Big Data for Business Decisions
*MSc. Elective*

Advanced data-science methods applied to managerial and accounting
problems: from data wrangling at scale to predictive modeling and the
use of textual and unstructured data in business decisions.

### Statistical and Computational Methods in Accounting
*BSc. in Artificial Intelligence — Elective*

Statistical learning, computational statistics, and modern programming
practices applied to accounting data. Connects the foundations of
statistical inference to the analytical workflows used in research and
industry.

### Introduction to Blockchain
*BSc. Elective*

A hands-on introduction to distributed ledger technologies: cryptographic
primitives, consensus, smart contracts, and the accounting/auditing
implications of on-chain data.
[*Bocconi Teaching Award for Innovation, 2023–2024.*]{.text-muted}

## Student advising

Since 2018 I have advised more than **40 MSc.** and **30 BSc.** students
on theses spanning corporate disclosure, NLP, machine learning, and
blockchain applications in accounting.

Prospective advisees: please email me a short note describing your
background and the questions you would like to work on.
